canh: a narrow lane in the City of London in the 1930s
loi_cau: In the 1930s, taller office blocks begin to rise near the cathedral, blocking some of its best-known views. But the lanes underneath hardly shift.
mo_ta: Canh duong pho London thap nien 1930 voi nguoi di bo va nha tho phia xa.

muc.mo_ta: Cot khoi hoac hoi nuoc boc len giua long duong.
